source: @kiro/agent/dist/server/acp-server.js: VZu (client provider), KWe (grep_search tool), qZu (rg --json parser), Rar (path mapping)
kasAccepts: any answer whose matches member is truthy, an empty array included; KAS returns it unchanged (no path remap, no cap)
kasFallsBack: an answer with no matches member (metric textSearch.clientProvider.fault MalformedResponse)
kasTimeout: none: extMethod is sendRequest with no timeout or abort signal, so KAS waits for the answer however long it takes and a turn cancel does not end the wait
fileRanking: files ranked by match count descending then path ascending; entries within a file by line number
pathForm: root-relative to the first root it resolves under; a file under a later root is prefixed with that root's base name when the bare relative path would resolve under the first root (Rar over MJ)
